scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.check:python: uv run python -m unittest discover -s site/scripts -p 'test_*.py' -q && uv run pytest -q tests docs/programmable-character/test_verify_contract.py && uv run ruff format --check src tests docs/programmable-character/verify_contract.py docs/programmable-character/test_verify_contract.py pyproject.toml && uv run ruff check src tests docs/programmable-character/verify_contract.py docs/programmable-character/test_verify_contract.py pyproject.toml && uv run mypy
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:python
scripts.check:release: npm run check:all && npm run acceptance
